text:
Evaporation occurs from the surface of a pool of water.
Which statement describes this change of state?
A
Electrons move from the liquid and become a gas.
B
Molecules that move from the liquid have the same energy as those that stay in the liquid.
C
The more energetic molecules escape the liquid.
D
The more energetic molecules remain in the liquid.

options.label: A
options.text: Electrons move from the liquid and become a gas.

options.label: B
options.text: Molecules that move from the liquid have the same energy as those that stay in the liquid.

options.label: C
options.text: The more energetic molecules escape the liquid.

options.label: D
options.text: The more energetic molecules remain in the liquid.
